# KERF 3D STUDIO
> Precision additive manufacturing atelier, architectural design store, and on-demand FDM 3D printing service based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Kerf 3D Studio operates an active production fleet of direct-drive Bambu Lab A1 3D printers, delivering micron-calibrated fabrication (±0.15mm mechanical tolerance) across architectural thermoplastics and engineering composites. The workshop features an automated online volumetric slicing engine for custom CAD uploads (.STL, .OBJ, .3MF) and a curated catalog of tactile desk artifacts, carry gear, and ambient lighting.

## Key Facts & Technical Capabilities
- **Location**: Dhaka Atelier, Bangladesh (Coordinates: 23.8103° N, 90.4125° E).
- **Production Hardware**: Bambu Lab A1 direct-drive fleet with active vibration compensation and automatic flow calibration.
- **Maximum Build Envelope**: 256 × 256 × 256 mm (continuous build volume).
- **Available Nozzle Orifices**: 0.2 mm (high-resolution miniatures), 0.4 mm (standard production), 0.6 mm & 0.8 mm (structural load-bearing).
- **Stocked Thermopolymers**: Renewable Bio-PLA, Glycol-modified PETG, Flexible TPU 95A Elastomer, Weather-resistant ASA, and Carbon Fiber Polyamide (PA-CF).
- **Fulfillment & Logistics**: 24—48 hours delivery inside Dhaka (Free delivery on orders over ৳1,200 BDT); 2—4 days nationwide courier dispatch across Bangladesh.
- **Payment Intake**: Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide; Instant mobile financial settlements via bKash, Nagad, and Rocket (Personal MFS).

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://kerf3d.store/): Core atelier overview, active print queue telemetry, featured specimen gallery, and engineering standards.
- [Catalog & Specimen Archive](https://kerf3d.store/shop): Searchable catalog of 450+ curated functional 3D printed artifacts with material and color variant selection.
- [Instant CAD Slicing Configurator](https://kerf3d.store/quote): Real-time browser-based 3D model volume calculator, layer orientation preview, infill density adjuster, and instant BDT pricing.
- [Hardware & Materials Engineering Guide](https://kerf3d.store/materials): Comprehensive technical spec sheet comparing tensile strengths, heat deflection temperatures, infill geometries, and tolerances.
- [Workshop Dispatch & Telemetry Tracker](https://kerf3d.store/track): Live order fulfillment tracker inspecting intake queues, Bambu Studio slicing status, and courier tracking numbers.
